### 💰 Goldman Sachs — Most Recent Annual Revenue

| Fiscal Year End | Revenue | Filed |
|---|---|---|
| December 31, 2025 | **$58.28 billion** | February 25, 2026 |

---

**Key Details:**
- The figure is sourced from Goldman Sachs's **10-K filing** (annual report) submitted to the SEC on **February 25, 2026**.
- The metric used is **Revenues Net of Interest Expense**, which is the standard top-line revenue measure Goldman Sachs reports. Because Goldman is a financial services firm (not a traditional corporation), it nets interest expenses against interest income before reporting revenue — so this is the most comparable figure to "revenue" for a bank or investment firm.
- At **$58.3 billion**, this represents Goldman's full-year 2025 performance across its business segments, including Global Banking & Markets, Asset & Wealth Management, and Platform Solutions.
